homeDescription: Home counts as Lived and Visited. Former homes stay Lived.
dataDescription: Saved on this device. Export a backup to keep a copy.
clearTravelMessage: Removes all countries, regions, and home. Keeps your settings. Cannot be undone.
resetMessage: Resets settings to defaults. Keeps your countries, regions, and home.
resetAppDescription: Erase all saved app data and return to the initial state.
resetAppMessage: Permanently deletes all countries, regions, home, preferences, and temporary backup files in the app. This cannot be undone. Backups saved elsewhere and iOS permissions are not changed.
appDescription: Your visited places, homes, and wishlist. Saved on this device.
